items.title: llama.cpp DSpine draft-model port: per-GPU speculative-decoding numbers from DGX Spark, Radeon R9700 and RX 7800 XT
items.summary: A community llama.cpp port of the DSpine drafter now has benchmark numbers on four GPU types. The best --spec-draft-n-max depends on the card, and on some cards the older dflash2 or mtp drafters are faster for chat, while DSpine stays ahead for code and tool calls.

items.title: Docling v2.149.0 adds a MiniCPM-OCR preset, opt-in native-pixel PDF figure extraction and torch-free Mac ASR
items.summary: The Docling release adds a minicpm_ocr preset so a 1.3B OCR model can run on one consumer GPU, an opt-in flag that pulls figures from PDFs at native resolution, and ASR on mlx-audio without torch on Macs.

items.title: Base M4 Mac mini 24GB median 51.8 tok/s on MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B-A3B with llama.cpp and a draft model
items.summary: A one-week follow-up reports a median of 51.8 tok/s over 802 answers on a base M4 Mac mini, up from 38.6, after switching to the official IQ3_XS quant and keeping a 237 MB draft model. It lists the full launch flags and a paired benchmark, and states the unexplained gains and failures.

doubt.pushback: Self-reported single-machine numbers; the author notes one gain from Nov 4 is unexplained.
